# Minimal template record fixtures

These files are framework test inputs, independent of the replaceable root `content/`, `config/`, and `public/` directories.

- `weapon.json`, `weapon-detail.json`, and `weapon-detail.mdx`: minimal weapon page overlay for `tests/fixtures/input/site` used by generation/anchor tests. No additional categories or assets are needed.
- `boss-index.json`: one entity and one attack for nested evidence validation.

Keep these fixtures minimal. They are not complete example sites and are not publication content.
